caption: The video captures a close-up view of a cream-colored sink basin where a thin stream of water already pours down from the top edge onto a translucent, gel-like mass that drapes over the drain at the lower right. A crumpled, glossy piece of plastic sits at the drain opening, and the left wall of the basin is slick with scattered droplets and bright specular reflections. The stream remains continuous, striking the upper surface of the translucent mass and producing bright bubbles along with shifting highlights that travel across its wet form. The mass itself holds its overall shape as the water flows over and around it. A blurry blue-gray object occupies the lower-left foreground, staying roughly in place while the drain and wet wall stay broadly in place. Toward the end a blue bottle with white lettering becomes progressively more visible at the top-left edge, while the water keeps running and the mass keeps glistening under the stream.
